# Rajawali D'Cabin Chalet

> Muslim-friendly riverside chalet and roomstay in Chendering, Kuala Terengganu, Malaysia. Eight private cabins for family staycations near the city.

Rajawali D'Cabin Chalet offers eight private wooden cabins along the river in Chendering, a short drive from central Kuala Terengganu. The site supports online booking secured by a refundable RM50 security deposit per room (separate from the room rate, refunded after check-out subject to room inspection) and provides guests a self-serve way to manage their reservations. Up to 2 children under 12 years old stay free per room, sharing the existing bedding.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the chalet, amenities, nearby attractions, and FAQs.
- [Book a Cabin](/book): Check availability and reserve a private cabin online.

## Optional

- [Find your booking](/find-booking): Recover a lost booking management link by email.

_Note: owner sign-in, booking management, and unsubscribe pages are private utility routes and intentionally excluded._
